gen-press-start-2p-gf-changa: Press Start 2P pins its big, open-bowled lowercase far apart like cut-out letters, while Changa sits beneath it with sturdy, cast-iron stature. Down a full page, Changa stays clean and modern, a sans with heft.
gen-press-start-2p-gf-farro: Arcade-bright and playful up top, then a hush below. Press Start 2P spaces its cut-out letters far apart while Farro, a sans-serif bent from one length of wire, stays compact; that tension is the whole charm.
gen-press-start-2p-gf-fragment-mono: Fragment Mono lays its letters out like nails on a ruler, a monospace with a high waist line and no stroke contrast. Press Start 2P supplies the retro fun against all that order.
gen-press-start-2p-gf-genos: Fun and retro up top, in Press Start 2P. Press Start 2P excels at loud, spaced-out display lines, while Genos packs its glyphs close with a high midline for text that never snags.
gen-press-start-2p-gf-hammersmith-one: Arcade fun meets rope-soft lettering: Press Start 2P spaces its cut-out letters far apart above Hammersmith One. And the pairing's strength is how that jumpy spacing sits against flat, single-weight rounded strokes.
gen-press-start-2p-gf-magra: Magra fills every lowercase word with a big-bodied feel, a sans with barely any stroke contrast. Magra carries the words, leaving Press Start 2P, with its lightly sprung strokes, to work big and short.
gen-press-start-2p-gf-menbere: Clean and upright, Menbere stacks its lowercase like rolled cord under the heavier verticals of Press Start 2P. And over a full page, Menbere keeps a quiet, uncluttered rhythm.
gen-press-start-2p-gf-mitr: Press Start 2P goes loud, retro and a bit playful. It's built for big display lines, while Mitr keeps capitals and lowercase close in height for steady running text.
gen-press-start-2p-gf-momo-trust-display: Cut-out letters pinned far apart give Press Start 2P its arcade look, with a lightly flexed spring-wire stroke. Momo Trust Display does the quiet work, a sans with a generous x-height, while the heading does the shouting.
gen-press-start-2p-gf-mukta: Press Start 2P spaces its cut-out letters far apart, with a gentle taper from stem to joint, before Mukta takes over. Arcade-bright fun above, and clean, sturdy small letters below.
